basic_info.description: This stately Edwardian mansion has a secret inner garden with a fountain. A serene oasis, it is privately deeded to a one bedroom/bathroom condominium with a desirable floor plan that is located in prime Pac Heights. The outdoor living and dining areas feature several types of mature tropical flora that create a soothing green backdrop when glancing out of the home's many windows. The refreshed kitchen has french door stainless fridge, stainless dishwasher, full size gas range, and black quartz coutertops. The high ceilings and west facing hall window bring natural light throughout the day. The living room ceiling is dramtically punctuated with original beams, making it the most formal space in the home. Separated from the busy tree lined street, this peaceful Pac Heights escape is flanked by Alta Plaza  &  Lafayette Parks and a stone's throw from Fillmore's luxe shops and eateries. Peace, privacy, tranquility and convenience await. Come see how great life can be in Pacific Heights!
